# StopNetGame

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Multiplayer](BlitzBasic-Multiplayer)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
StopNetGame
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Leaves or ends the game. Players of this program are removed.
